title: Canton, OH — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Canton, OH: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Canton is a city in OH with a population of 71,000. Hall of Fame City with the Pro Football Hall of Fame and the McKinley Presidential Library. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree.
